decisions.reason: As a lightly signaled and comparatively less core consumer-facing offer, this product appears to have revealed limited early traction quickly enough that its option value is lower than the benefit of reallocating attention to the firm's stronger technology pipeline.

Because this modular extension fits the firm's established waste-to-energy and engineering business and industrial adoption cycles are long, uncertainty is still unresolved and the option should be kept open at least another period.

Its dedicated product page suggests above-average internal commitment or market interest, and as a core energy-conversion technology it retains substantial upside while uncertainty is still resolving.

Although still early and only lightly featured, plastic-to-fuel is close to the firm's capabilities and strategic sustainability direction, so preserving the option is justified until more market evidence arrives.
